change_summary: Add a non-zero max_source_bytes budget (8 MiB default) to the isolated invocation contract v3 and reject oversized untrusted sources before allocation and again before process launch.
Bind max_lean_threads into the isolation contract and launch pinned Lean with an explicit single worker by default.
Resolve the pinned Lake binary before entering the network-disabled sandbox and qualify one accepted and one rejected theorem through the isolated Rust API.
Keep the trusted verify_file path unchanged and preserve the exact sealed source bytes passed to Bubblewrap.

premerge_validation.review: Exact six-file diff inspected; one outdated thread about the actual Lake binary was resolved after elan which lake was implemented. No independent third-party approval is claimed.
successful_steps: Pinned Lean build and leanchecker --fresh ProofLab
Accepted and rejected pinned Lean through the isolated Rust API

discarded_attempts.reason: Rust passed; final isolated Lean API gate failed with failed to create thread. This run is diagnostic only.
Adding Lean -j 1 preserved all gates but the final real-Lean isolation test still failed to create a thread.

successful_steps: Rust format, Clippy and workspace tests
Pinned Lean dependency resolution and build

acceptance_met: All untrusted source entrypoints enforce a pre-allocation input budget and recheck before isolated launch.
The isolated contract binds source bytes, maximum input size and Lean worker count; legacy v2 receipts fail closed.
A pinned real Lean toolchain is accepted/rejected through the isolated Rust API on the candidate and exact integrated main tree.
acceptance_pending: Define and qualify aggregate host/cgroup CPU, memory and PID policy for hostile concurrent workloads; per-process prlimit is not evidence of aggregate host enforcement.
